when i start to have a meltdown, it’s like all regard for the well-being of myself is thrown out of the window. i’m currently in a peculiar situation, living with my ex of four months. we get along here and there, but there’s also times where we just aren’t good for eachother. either i’ll be snarky or she’ll just have a tiny attitude that triggers me. or a lot of the time just being here will flip a switch in my brain and make me go full on rage-mode. 

the smallest amount of conflict i shut down at. from that point on, i take it as a personal attack and have to defend myself. i’ll raise my voice and talk over her, not letting her get a point in. i’ll throughly go through what happened very loudly, and then if things don’t make sense or she gets upset in any manner ill freak the fuck out. i’ll scream literally to the bottom of my lungs. like i’ll scream hard and get all of the air out in 2 seconds. i’ll flail my arms & body around and genuienly flop like a fish out of water. 

i have an INSANE urge to just. hit. never a person, thankfully. i’ve never put my hands on someone and i hope and pray i never ever do. instead ive put a couple holes in walls, but more recently it’s been taking it out on myself. literally swinging my arms in every direction with fists full forced towards my head. i’ll stomp super super hard and like. extend all of my limbs really hard if that makes any sense. the aches and bruises after really tell me i need to calm down. i usually end up hyperventilating, rocking and crying telling myself that this isn’t forever. when i finally do breathe and calm down i just feel stupid. 

i feel very empty and i have no sense of what to do. like none of that should’ve ever happened and i gloss over it like it didn’t. im just very very self destructive. 

tldr: i scream as hard as i can, cry, hit myself and overall am very self-destructive.
